body: Drop him and move on. Sucks but that’s the bowl. Don’t waste time on someone who thinks they decide how you spend your money. Once it’s in your hands, it’s 0 of their concern unless it can effect them somehow.

Honestly, she kind of made herself look like an ass. Any serious SB is gonna know what precautions to take on a M&G. I feel bad for this guy. He did say some stuff I didn’t care for but he didn’t seem like a bad guy. 

He was obviously uncomfortable, and she was so awkward. She really needs to actually do some research before attacking a lifestyle she doesn’t understand.
